policy: Only entries marked used and permitted for hosted_private_use may be packaged. Reference-only sources may inform project-authored geometry but their source files are not redistributed.

assets.title: SKEL Data & Software
assets.reason: The licence is personal, single-user and non-transferable, and prohibits making the Data & Software available to a third party without prior written permission. Invited reviewers are third parties.

assets.title: SMPL-Model
assets.license: Custom single-user non-commercial scientific research licence
assets.reason: The licence prohibits copying, sharing, distribution, transfer and making the software available to third parties. No model download or agreement is present in this repository.

assets.title: SMPL-Body asset class
assets.variant: SMPL-Body without SMPL shape blendshapes or body-generation tools
assets.reason: The official licence permits sharing an SMPL-Body mesh and rig, but this phase has no concrete CC BY SMPL-Body asset to ledger. The licence page alone is not geometry.

assets.title: Open3DModel skeleton selection model

assets.reason: The project describes its model as CC BY-SA and explicitly permits hosting models when the Creative Commons requirements are followed. The archive is selected as the later source geometry; it is not vendored in this feasibility fixture.
